note: Letter boundaries inside six joined (cursive) words of the REAL page reference/handwriting_02.png, for the Phase 15 cursive feasibility check. x in ORIGINAL image pixels: where one letter ends and the next begins (the middle of the joining stroke), in order. Annotations only: no pixels.
method: Read off by eye from 7× enlarged crops with a 10-pixel ruler. Expected precision about ±1.5 px (the page's x-height is about 9 px). Annotated by the assistant, not by an independent human. One more word (“survival”) was tried and could not be annotated with confidence: its u / r / v / i strokes are not clearly separable even by eye.
